description: This PHP class defines a console command for restoring a database to a specified savepoint within the OrangeHRM system. It extends the base Command class and interacts with the DatabaseBackupService to perform the restore operation.

classes.name: RestoreDatabaseToSavepointCommand
classes.description: A console command that restores the database to a specific savepoint identified by name.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command's description and required arguments, specifically 'savepointName'.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the restore operation by calling the DatabaseBackupService and outputs the success message.
